quest.title: Time to Drink
quest.description: Heinry seems to have made some progress, but who knows just what kind of Fonta he's produced...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Good timing! Our research into Fonta has borne great fruit!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I've produced a bottle of what you might consider a "testing sample." You know, one that's in need of a "tester" to give some comments on it.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: And since you're here, why don't you give it a swig?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not going to cause me any problems, will it?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Oh, of course not! I've already tried it out, mind. I can guarantee that it shall do your health no harm.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In that case... here goes nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Don't worry, there'll be no issues. And in any case, I greatly appreciate your opinion! Come, let's head over there to conduct the test.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: A taste of delicious Fonta must, after all, be paired with lovely, open scenery to match!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: This bottle is yours. Fret not! This is the fruit of our joint efforts — there is no way it could taste bad.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Of course, there are issues that still need ironing out. For example, the processing of the ingredients, the amount of ingredients put in, and the optimal volume to which the bottle should be filled...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Even the bottle design itself shall require some thought. It is a new type of Fonta, after all, so we must give it a unique packaging to make an impression.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: You can leave those problems to me, though — just enjoy the Fonta, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I filled this bottle of Fonta with enough to serve two, so it should serve you just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Thanks again for your help. Remember our motto! "Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, give me a new bottle of Fonta then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: No problem. Just wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Alright, I've filled this bottle of Fonta with enough to serve two once again, so it should serve you just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: No matter what, do remember — "Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll keep the contents of the bottle.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Well, alright, I respect your decision. But please, under no circumstances should you drink this Fonta. After such a long time, I fear that its flavor will be... most strange.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: This bottle is yours. Fret not! This is the fruit of our joint efforts — there is no way it could taste bad.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Of course, there are issues that still need ironing out. For example, the processing of the ingredients, the amount of ingredients put in, and the optimal volume to which the bottle should be filled...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Even the bottle design itself shall require some thought. It is a new type of Fonta, after all, so we must give it unique packaging to make an impression.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: You can leave those problems to me, though — just enjoy the Fonta, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I filled this bottle of Fonta with enough to serve two, so it should serve you just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Oh, have you not yet had time to drink the bottle of Fonta I provided you with?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Considering the amount of time that's passed, this bottle might no longer be drinkable. Pass it to me, would you? I'll give you a new bottle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you leave both bottles with me?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Sorry, but the bottle of Fonta I gave you was specially made to have excellent sealing properties.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I only managed to make one such bottle at the moment... So if I want to fill it with new Fonta, we'll have to pour its current contents out.
